title: Is _MM_TRANSPOSE4_PS (8 instructions) minimal?
statement: The textbook SIMD shuffle, in every game engine and BLAS microkernel; universally believed optimal, never proved. 16 tags, 4 registers, ~2.5k vars at depth 8. Effort estimate: weeks.
